title: Owner→pipeline intake record (intake-decision)
description: Single JSONL record appended to .scratch/handoff.jsonl when intake for a slice concludes. Interactive: the intake skill's expert-persona discussion ends by recording the owner's request and decisions, quoted verbatim. Headless: pipeline preparation seeds the record from the task prompt's decision clauses. The router dispatches product-requirements-expert on this record (rule intake-ready); the expert grounds the slice's prd-entry in these quotes. Root appends and relays the record; it never paraphrases the content.

type.description: Discriminator. Always "intake-decision" for this record type.

req_id.description: Requirement ID minted at intake for the slice this record authorizes. The prd-entry that follows carries the same ID.

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; stamped by handoff.py append at write time.

author.description: Always "human": the record's authority derives from the owner's own statements, whichever front door recorded them.

request.description: The owner's request, quoted verbatim. Interactive: the owner's opening statement. Headless: the whole task prompt. Context for the product expert — never scope-override authority (Gate 1 quotes only from decisions).

decisions.description: The owner's decisions, each quoted verbatim from the intake discussion or the task prompt's decision clauses. The only intake text Gate 1 accepts as a scope-override quote. Empty when the owner stated no decision beyond the request.

source.description: Which front door recorded the intake: the interactive persona discussion or headless seeding from the task prompt.

notes.description: Optional. Open points the owner deliberately left unsettled; the product-requirements-expert resolves them by consultation, never by assumption.
